high_level_description: The image is a page from a publication, specifically Issue No. 10 of "System," which is dated Autumn/Winter 2017. The background is plain white, and the text is presented in a clean, modern font. The main content of the image is a quote attributed to Rem Koolhaas. The quote reads: "'Existence minimum' refers to the minimum people need to exist. People find that frightening because they're addicted to luxury, but I find it sympathetic." The quote is centered on the page and occupies most of the space. The text is black, making it stand out against the white
